rationale: Direct experimental testing in the available literature does not support a dominant-negative mechanism localized specifically to phosphopeptide-binding grooves as a unifying model. Functional studies on pathogenic YWHAZ missense variants demonstrate distinct molecular mechanisms: Popov et al. (2019) demonstrated that the recurrent S230W missense variant acts as a gain-of-function allele that hyperactivates Raf-ERK/MAPK signaling, whereas Wan et al. (2023) showed that the p.Lys49Asn variant exhibits a loss-of-function effect phenocopied by gene knockdown. Furthermore, both missense and truncating/frameshift variants cause neurodevelopmental phenotypes (Popov-Chang syndrome / YWHAZ-related disorders), indicating that haploinsufficiency/loss-of-function is also pathogenic rather than consistently milder than missense variants.

evidence.text: Functional evaluation of the de novo YWHAZ missense variant S230W demonstrated that the variant enhanced Raf-stimulated ERK phosphorylation and acted via a gain-of-function mechanism in the RAS-ERK pathway rather than a dominant-negative mechanism.

source.title: A YWHAZ Variant Associated With Cardiofaciocutaneous ...
source.quote: Our data provide strong support to the hypothesis that the S230W variant of YWHAZ is a gain-of-function mutation in the RAS-ERK pathway and may underlie a CFC phenotype.

evidence.text: Characterization of the p.Lys49Asn missense variant in a three-generation family revealed that the mutation behaved as a loss-of-function allele, and Drosophila knockdown models replicated the cognitive and behavioral deficits seen with the variant.

source.title: YWHAZ variation causes intellectual disability and global ...
source.quote: Computational modeling showed that the binding energy was increased in the mutated protein combining with the ligand indicating that the c147A > T variation was a loss-of-function variant. Cognitive defects and mushroom body morphological abnormalities were observed in YWHAZ c.147A > T knockin flies. The YWHAZ knockdown flies also manifested serious cognitive defects with hyperactivity behaviors, which is consistent with the clinical features.

evidence.text: Popov-Chang syndrome and related phenotypes are caused by both heterozygous missense and truncating/frameshift variants across multiple cohorts, demonstrating that loss-of-function alleles are fully pathogenic.

conflicts: Popov et al. (2019) demonstrated a gain-of-function mechanism in the RAS-MAPK pathway for the S230W variant, directly contrasting with the hypothesis of a dominant-negative effect.

Wan et al. (2023) demonstrated that a groove-region missense variant (p.Lys49Asn) produced a loss-of-function effect similar to YWHAZ knockdown, conflicting with the assertion of dominant-negative antagonism over haploinsufficiency.

new_directions.question_text: Do specific missense variants in YWHAZ selectively destabilize 14-3-3 dimeric partner interactions (dominant-negative) versus causing uncoupled Raf-ERK activation (gain-of-function)?
new_directions.rationale: Direct biochemical dimer-assembly assays and co-immunoprecipitation with standard 14-3-3 targets would resolve whether any human disease variants truly exert dominant-negative effects over wild-type monomers.

new_directions.question_text: What is the systematic clinical difference between individuals with YWHAZ truncating/frameshift variants versus missense variants in the amphipathic binding groove?
new_directions.rationale: Systematic deep-phenotyping across multicenter cohorts (such as ERN-ITHACA) is needed to determine if severity, dysmorphic features, or cardiac involvement systematically diverge by variant type.
